projection.units: dimensionless uncalibrated DAMIT coordinates; physical scale from the documented calibration

surfaces.coverage: Convex lightcurve reconstruction at approximate thermal scale: 17.98 km effective diameter (catalog ±1.34 km; additional model uncertainty). Grid marks unavailable imagery; pole ambiguity is retained in source notes. AKARI fitted nonrotating-sphere effective diameter is transferred as a uniform volume-scale approximation to this independently obtained shape model. Quoted catalog error is statistical and omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model uncertainty. No total confidence interval or local terrain accuracy is inferred. Kemi has one catalog detection; this limited measurement support remains explicit.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
